title: Excel upload, persisted AI fields, Claude-style UI
body: Upload Excel (.xlsx/.xls) as well as CSV. AI enrichment and growth fields now persist to the database, so History re-export and the RTM Data page keep them. Icons are self-hosted (work offline). Export is now one Excel report plus a full-dataset CSV. The whole UI moved to a softer, rounded Claude.ai style across every page.

title: Initial release
body: Pareto 80/15/5 classification per branch, F4 distributor as first-class, outlet lifecycle cohorts, parallel AI insights with cost tracking, 8-tab analytics, roles + groups + permissions, LDAP/Active Directory, and job sharing.
